claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Isradipine is a dihydropyridine L-type calcium channel blocker that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would be weak and non-selective, likely reflecting calcium-channel-independent off-target effects rather than a specific cytotoxic mechanism.
